about: AI newsreaders on air, taking turns by hour (hour % count). Owner approved (2026-10-08) ladies Sana, Ayesha, Zara, Hina, Mehwish, Priya (Hindi), Areeba and the six men Imran, Faisal, Kamran, Tariq, Saad, Hassan. Owner kept four newsrooms (2026-10-08): each reader's clip in a room is <reader><room letter>; headlines by day Q (daytime, city windows), at night N (busy newsroom); full report by day T (two floors), at night R (evening, wall of screens). Day = 06:00-17:59 Toronto. build-news.yml downloads every clip (make_news.py --reader-ids) from channel-media news-move-<id>-raw.mp4.
